privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How {siteName} collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information {siteName} collects and how we use it. We aim to collect as little as possible.
privacy.collectBody:
• Ad content you provide: title, description, category, location, price and photos.
  • Contact details you provide: your name and email address. Your email is used to verify your ad, to send you status updates and renewal reminders, and to relay buyer enquiries. It is never published.
  • Technical data: a one-way, salted hash of your IP address (never the raw address) and basic request data, used for rate limiting and abuse prevention.
privacy.useBody:
• To publish and display your ad once a moderator approves it.
  • To relay messages between buyers and sellers without exposing email addresses.
  • To keep the site safe, including spam and scam prevention.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your data. We share it only with the service providers needed to run the site (for example, email delivery and bot protection) or where required by law.
privacy.retentionBody: Ads and their photos are retained while the ad is live and for a reasonable period after expiry, then removed. Verification links expire automatically.
privacy.choicesBody: You can ask us to remove your ad at any time using the manage link sent with your ad, or by contacting us.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use a single essential cookie to keep administrators signed in. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.note: This is a template policy provided for the demo build. Review it with a qualified professional before relying on it in production.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.metaDescription: The rules for using {siteName}, including our family-safe content policy.
terms.intro: By using {siteName} you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
terms.policyIntro: {siteName} is a family-safe marketplace. The following are not allowed:
terms.policyBody:
• Personals, dating, escort or any adult content.
  • Gambling and casino promotions.
  • Weapons, ammunition and replica firearms.
  • Illegal drugs, pharmaceuticals and controlled substances.
  • Live animal sales (restricted species), wildlife trafficking or breeder listings.
  • Stolen goods, counterfeit items, or anything unlawful in your jurisdiction.
  • Spam, scams, phishing and misleading offers.

Automated keyword filters flag suspicious listings and every ad is reviewed by a human before it appears. We may reject or remove any ad at our discretion.
terms.postingBody:
• You must be able to lawfully sell or advertise what you post.
  • Provide accurate details and genuine photos you have the right to use.
  • Do not post duplicate or misleading listings.
terms.responsibilitiesBody: You are responsible for your dealings with other users. {siteName} is a venue that connects buyers and sellers; we do not take part in transactions and are not responsible for the items, services or conduct of users.
terms.expiryBody: Approved ads run for a limited period (currently {expiryDays} days) and can be renewed using the link we email you.
terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we exclude liability for any loss arising from use of the site or from dealings between users.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms. Continued use of the site means you accept the updated terms.
terms.note: This is a template provided for the demo build. Review it with a qualified professional before relying on it in production.

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.metaDescription: Practical tips to stay safe when buying and selling on {siteName}.
safety.intro: Buying and selling locally is usually friendly and safe. A few simple habits keep it that way.
safety.meetingBody:
• Meet in a busy, well-lit public place during the day.
  • Take a friend or family member along.
  • Tell someone where you are going and when you expect to be back.
  • Trust your instincts — if something feels wrong, walk away.
safety.paymentsBody:
• Inspect the item before you pay.
  • Prefer cash or a secure, traceable method on collection.
  • Never send deposits, gift cards or cryptocurrency to someone you haven't met.
  • Be wary of prices that are too good to be true.
safety.scamsBody:
• Requests to move the chat off-platform immediately.
  • Overpayment offers, or "shipping agents" for a local item.
  • Pressure to pay quickly or pay before seeing the item.
  • Sellers who refuse an inspection.

If you spot a scam or a prohibited listing, use the Report this ad button on the ad. Our moderators review every report.
safety.sellingBody:
• Keep your email private — use our relay contact form.
  • Remove any personal details from photos (number plates, documents, house numbers).
  • Ask buyers to confirm a time before meeting.
safety.emergencyBody: In an emergency, always contact your local emergency services first (in {countryName}, call {emergency}).
